name: Alexa
source:
A magic user and a self-proclaimed "witch."

She's always getting drunk and causing trouble at taverns, and meets Aruji when he's hired to resolve the mess. From then on she becomes an evil presence who always finds reasons to demand free drinks.

[Translated from the [url=https://kelpy.net/index02/character06.php]official website[/url]]
